Idempotent: calling it again (were that ever possible -- it isn't, once the account can no longer authenticate) is a safe no-op.

ai_jobs.client_boundary: Mobile calls Django only. Django dispatches to the internal Baraq AI service; internal /api/internal/v1/ai/ routes are excluded.
ai_jobs.failure: Failed jobs expose error_code and an end-user-safe error_message; reserved usage is refunded when credits were not committed.

feedback.forwarding: Django schedules forwarding to the internal AI service after commit; Mobile never calls that service.
feedback.ownership: The job queryset is scoped to request.user.
feedback.upsert: Unique (job, user); a repeat POST updates the same feedback and returns 200, first POST returns 201.

ai_jobs.idempotency: Django derives an idempotency key from the user, task/context, normalized input and parameters. Matching non-terminal/nonfailed jobs are returned with HTTP 200; force=true creates a fresh key.

fahes_generate_quiz.source_ids: Derived by Django from one source or up to 10 usable collection sources; never client-supplied.

kholasa_generate_summary.source_ids: Derived by Django from one source or up to 10 usable collection sources; never client-supplied.

khota_generate_plan.exam_dates: object with string subject ids and ISO-date values
khota_generate_plan.source_ids: Derived by Django from one source or up to 10 usable collection sources; may be empty.
khota_generate_plan.subject_ids: Derived from request subject when present, otherwise input.subject_ids (at most 20 text values); at least one is required.

rasheed_recommendations.metrics: Django derives submitted-quiz attempts and average percentage; clients cannot supply authoritative metrics.

sada_transcribe_audio.source_id: Derived by Django from the owned audio source; exactly one source is required.

ai_jobs.result_delivery: Completed jobs have result_type and result_id. Materialized results are read through summaries, quizzes, study plans, recommendations, or transcriptions as applicable.
ai_jobs.source_context: Request fields are singular project, source, collection, subject plus input and parameters. There is no source_ids, collection_id, or user_instruction top-level request field.
ai_jobs.source_shortcuts: Owned source/collection character actions create the same server-side AI job flow; generic use-with-character accepts character and optional action, while fixed-character shortcuts accept no request schema.

sada_transcribe_audio.requires: exactly one owned audio source; collections are rejected

ai_jobs.usage: Django reserves character usage when a job is created, commits on completion, and refunds eligible failed/canceled jobs.

project_source_relationship.constraints: A source/collection project must be owned by the user; a source or collection with a project makes an AI job inherit that project and rejects a mismatching request project. A source in a collection inherits the collection project.
project_source_relationship.difference_from_preferred_architecture: Summaries, transcriptions and recommendations relate to AI jobs and source/collection (where applicable), not directly to Project.
project_source_relationship.implemented: Project is an owned UUID-keyed workspace. Sources, source collections, AI jobs, quizzes and study plans each have optional project foreign keys.

source_upload.ownership_and_context: Optional project, subject and collection must be owned/active as validated. Collection subject/project can be inherited; mismatching project values are rejected.
source_upload.processing: Upload queues processing. Text files are extracted locally and become ready; other accepted files are stored with processing metadata awaiting AI-service extraction. POST process queues processing and returns 202 with message and source.
source_upload.request_requirements: title and file are required; the view requires request.FILES so a file upload representation is required in practice.
source_upload.validation: The backend checks filename extension, file signature and Office archive safety. It rejects executable/archive/script-style dangerous extensions.

subscriptions_and_usage.client_mutations: No mobile subscription upgrade, cancellation or payment endpoint is implemented.
subscriptions_and_usage.current_entitlement: GET /api/v1/subscriptions/me/ lazily creates/returns the current subscription plus plan, usage, limits, features and remaining entitlement.
subscriptions_and_usage.plan_catalog: GET /api/v1/subscriptions/plans/ is public and lists active public plans.

missing_expected_capabilities.backend_changes_required: Implement provider-safe payment orchestration and entitlement transition validation; do not trust client payment state.
missing_expected_capabilities.desired_capability: Subscription self-service purchase, upgrade, downgrade, and cancellation
missing_expected_capabilities.why: Mobile can read plans and its current entitlement, but has no backend payment or plan-change route.

missing_expected_capabilities.backend_changes_required: Add authoritative models, event ledger, privacy rules and routes.
missing_expected_capabilities.desired_capability: Gamification profile, points, streaks, achievements and leaderboard
missing_expected_capabilities.why: No gamification models or client routes exist in the current backend.

missing_expected_capabilities.backend_changes_required: Add an owned preference model and enforce it in notification producers.
missing_expected_capabilities.why: Notification read/list actions exist, but no preference model or endpoint exists.

missing_expected_capabilities.backend_changes_required: Add source storage/validation/processing paths without bypassing ownership and quota checks.
missing_expected_capabilities.why: StudentSource has text/link source types, but the implemented create serializer requires a file upload; no text-body or URL ingestion route exists.

missing_expected_capabilities.backend_changes_required: Define authoritative aggregation, pagination/time windows and privacy boundaries.
missing_expected_capabilities.why: Mobile has AI-generated recommendations, but no direct performance/time-series analytics endpoint.
